svg.title: Known-best packing of 270 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=270 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-17 exact rational centre-direction certificate at 270, read exactly from the retained source file n270/n270_exact.json at a1ba501, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#1022 names: the packing of Asterios Panoras's Kaggle compilation with its end regions relaxed and a bottom region compressed. Finite construction feasibility only; local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=270 known best: side ~ 16.92731422 (certified upper bound)
